# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU correctness updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 improves GPU geometry, clipping, and displacement-filter correctness without changing the public managed API. These native fixes retain the Skia m157 engine line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles** — Corrects axis mapping for corner radii and stroke widths, removes the redundant quarter-turn swap, and clamps radii to half the transformed bounds to prevent overlapping corners. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Atlas work after empty flushes** — Updates Ganesh flush-token tracking so atlas work from one flush is not incorrectly considered pending in a later flush. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Graphite clip capacity** — Includes unrecorded clips in pass-capacity checks without double-counting recorded clips. A draw whose full clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass is warned about and skipped; a pass exactly at capacity remains valid. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Displacement-filter precision** — Computes displacement scale and offsets at float precision to match filter bounds and avoid rounding differences in sampling positions. Color-channel samples and selectors remain half precision. ([#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Native Vulkan synchronization reporting** — Propagates failed fence waits into the native synchronous submission result, preserving timeout retries and asynchronous behavior. GRContext.Submit remains void and discards that result; no managed failure-reporting API is added. ([#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
